correct_recommendations: Remove the digest_builder line from the crontab of ops-box-2 as the primary fix. A unique index on outbox(subscriber_id, digest_date) may follow as a secondary guard.
invalid_options: Remove or disable the Kubernetes CronJob digest-builder instead of the legacy crontab line.
Remove the rotate-logs line of ops-box-2 as part of this fix without a check.
The unique index or the digest-mailer dedupe as the primary fix, with the crontab removal as a secondary step or absent.
root_cause: jobs.digest_builder runs twice every Monday at 06:00: from the Kubernetes CronJob digest-builder and from a leftover crontab line on ops-box-2. The September cutover checklist left the removal of that line open. digest_builder inserts without a check for existing rows.

dependent_facts.true_value: the item to remove the digest_builder line from ops-box-2 is still open since the 21 September cutover
two runs on 26 October, from ops-box-2 and from a pod, each enqueuing 18412 rows
digest_builder inserts one outbox row per active subscriber with no check for existing rows
no unique constraint on outbox(subscriber_id, digest_date)

required_questions.question: Why are digests sent twice?
required_questions.expected_answer: digest_builder runs twice, from Kubernetes and from the ops-box-2 crontab.

required_questions.question: Why does the second run exist?
required_questions.expected_answer: The September cutover left the crontab line on ops-box-2; the checklist item is open.

required_questions.question: What is removed and what stays?
required_questions.expected_answer: The digest_builder crontab line on ops-box-2 is removed; the Kubernetes CronJob digest-builder stays.

required_questions.question: Why not the two fixes I proposed?
required_questions.expected_answer: Both treat the symptom; the double run remains. An index can stay as a guard.

required_questions.question: What can break?
required_questions.expected_answer: Nothing that depends on the ops-box-2 run; the Kubernetes job covers all subscribers.

valid_alternatives.option: Unique index on outbox(subscriber_id, digest_date) with insert on conflict do nothing
valid_alternatives.trade_off: Guards against any future double schedule, but needs a migration plus cleanup of existing duplicates, and the double run still does the work.
valid_alternatives.primary_when: The legacy crontab cannot be changed soon, or the team wants a guard against future double schedules.

valid_alternatives.trade_off: Code-only guard, but the double run and the duplicate rows remain.
valid_alternatives.primary_when: Neither the crontab nor the schema can change soon.

closing_decision: One decision: approve removal of the ops-box-2 digest_builder crontab line, or whether to add the unique index as a guard too.

understanding.problem: The Monday digest goes out twice to every subscriber.
understanding.breaks: digest_builder runs twice, from Kubernetes and from the leftover ops-box-2 crontab line, so every subscriber gets two outbox rows.
understanding.fix: Remove the digest_builder line from the ops-box-2 crontab.
understanding.cost: One crontab line; optionally a migration for a guard index.
